articles.title: Texas' Largest Family Entertainment Center Set to Open in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: A new FEC billing itself as the biggest in Texas is scheduled to open in Houston this year, signaling continued investor appetite for large-format indoor entertainment destinations. The project reflects a broader national trend of developers pursuing anchor-scale FEC concepts in major metros. Operators in the region should monitor its attraction mix and pricing strategy as a competitive benchmark.

articles.title: Launch Entertainment Expanding to Denton, TX with Trampolines, Arcade, and Duckpin Bowling
articles.summary: Launch Entertainment is set to open a new location at Golden Triangle Mall in Denton, Texas, combining trampolines, arcade games, and duckpin bowling under one roof. The move continues Launch's strategy of repurposing underutilized mall space into multi-attraction FEC venues. This format is worth watching for operators considering mixed-activity concepts to drive dwell time and repeat visits.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC Opens in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee Over Labor Day Weekend
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center debuted in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee, capitalizing on the high-traffic Labor Day holiday weekend for its grand opening. The venue adds to the growing cluster of FEC openings across smaller metro markets outside major cities. Operators tracking suburban expansion trends will find this opening relevant as a case study in community-focused venue launches.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC in LaPorte to Feature Bowling, Mini-Golf, and Arcade
articles.summary: A new multi-activity indoor family entertainment center is coming to LaPorte, Indiana, offering bowling, mini-golf, and arcade games. The venue illustrates the continued popularity of diversified activity mixes to appeal to broad family demographics. For FEC operators, the bundled attractions model remains a proven draw in mid-sized markets.

articles.title: Inside Pensacola's Massive New Launch Entertainment Complex
articles.summary: A reporter toured the upcoming Launch Entertainment complex in Pensacola, offering an early look at the scale and attraction mix planned for the facility. The venue is part of Launch's aggressive expansion strategy targeting mid-sized Sun Belt markets with large-format indoor entertainment. FEC operators can glean insights into facility design choices and the competitive positioning of trampoline-anchored multi-attraction venues.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Moves Forward with Build-Out at Jacksonville's Southside Commons
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park is advancing its construction plans at Southside Commons in Jacksonville, Florida, marking another significant FEC development in the Southeast. The project adds to a growing pipeline of adventure park openings that blend climbing, obstacle courses, and active entertainment. Jacksonville operators should take note as the venue is likely to compete for family leisure spending in the market.

articles.title: First Look: Renderings Released for MADCAPS Entertainment Center in Maricopa, AZ
articles.summary: New renderings reveal the planned design and layout for MADCAPS, an upcoming entertainment center in Maricopa, Arizona. The project represents the type of purpose-built FEC development gaining traction in fast-growing suburban communities in the Southwest. Operators and designers can use the renderings to benchmark current trends in facility aesthetics and attraction planning.

articles.title: Family Entertainment Center Planned for Former Big Lots Space in Wenatchee
articles.summary: A new FEC is being planned for a vacant former Big Lots retail space in Wenatchee, Washington, continuing the trend of repurposing big-box retail for entertainment use. This adaptive reuse model has become increasingly common as landlords seek entertainment tenants to revitalize struggling retail centers. FEC developers and operators should monitor lease terms and conversion costs as this model matures.

articles.title: The Pitch FEC Opens in Quincy with Wide Range of Indoor Activities
articles.summary: The Pitch, a new family entertainment center packed with indoor activities, has opened in Quincy, offering residents a new multi-attraction leisure destination. The opening reflects ongoing demand for locally owned FEC concepts in smaller cities and towns. Operators in similar markets may find the venue's activity mix and community positioning instructive.

articles.title: New Family-Focused Indoor Entertainment Complex Opens in Mountlake Terrace, WA
articles.summary: A new family-focused indoor entertainment complex has opened in Mountlake Terrace, Washington, expanding the FEC footprint in the Seattle metro area. The venue joins a competitive but growing market for indoor leisure options in the Pacific Northwest. Operators in the region will want to track its programming and membership offerings.

articles.title: Indoor Family Entertainment Concept Coming to Denton, Texas
articles.summary: An indoor family entertainment concept is in development for Denton, Texas, adding to the city's growing slate of FEC options alongside the announced Launch Entertainment venue. The simultaneous development of multiple FEC projects in the same market raises questions about saturation and differentiation strategies. Operators should watch how these venues position themselves against each other.

articles.title: Intercard's Impulse Plus Reader Earns Honorable Mention at 2026 Golden Ticket Awards
articles.summary: Intercard's Impulse Plus card reader received an honorable mention in the best innovation category at the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards, recognizing its contribution to cashless payment and access technology in the amusement industry. The recognition highlights continued innovation in FEC payment infrastructure, a critical operational system for arcade and token-based revenue centers. FEC operators evaluating reader upgrades should note this product's industry validation.

articles.title: Game Volt Debuts RFID-Connected Carnival Games Platform at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: Game Volt is premiering Carnival Games: The Supercharged Funfair at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, combining traditional midway games with RFID technology, networked leaderboards, and team competition features. The platform transforms standalone arcade games into a connected social experience that spans an entire venue. FEC operators looking to increase engagement and repeat play should pay close attention to this networked gaming model.

articles.title: Attractions Technology Should Deliver More Than Transactions, Says Industry Veteran
articles.summary: Andy Povey, managing director of Merac and a 20-year veteran of both operator and supplier roles, argues that ticketing and attractions technology must go beyond simple sales functions to deliver actionable data and deeper operational value. He cautions that over-reliance on technology risks eroding the human connection that defines great guest experiences. FEC operators should use this perspective as a framework when evaluating or renegotiating technology vendor relationships.

articles.title: Attraktion! to Supply Two New FlyXD Flying Theaters in Europe for 2027
articles.summary: Attraktion! has secured contracts to deliver two new FlyXD flying theater installations at European venues ahead of their 2027 openings, and will showcase an updated LED-equipped unit at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026. Flying theaters continue to be a high-impact anchor attraction for FECs and entertainment parks seeking immersive experiences without massive footprints. Operators considering premium immersive attractions should evaluate FlyXD as a scalable option.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Unveils SphereFly Immersive Simulator at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: DOF Robotics is revealing SphereFly, a new immersive simulation attraction designed for small spaces, at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026. The system seats guests in a suspended arrangement facing a curved screen with synchronized motion, making it viable for FECs with limited floor space. The company is also teasing a new Transformers collaboration, which could offer compelling licensed IP opportunities for operators.

articles.title: Attraktion! Installs Full Product Catalogue at Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: Attraktion! has completed an installation of its full product range at an adventure park in Poland, offering a real-world showcase of how its attractions perform together in a single venue. This type of comprehensive deployment gives operators a chance to evaluate multiple products in an operational context rather than a trade show setting. FEC buyers considering Attraktion! products should seek site visit opportunities at this location.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 to Host Largest Education Program in Event History
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 will feature its most expansive education program to date, with more than 180 speakers across over 70 sessions covering the full breadth of the attractions industry. For FEC operators unable to attend IAAPA Expo in Orlando, the European event offers significant professional development value. Attendees should plan their session schedules early given the scale of the program.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Signature Session Details and Speakers Announced
articles.summary: IAAPA has revealed details and speakers for this year's signature sessions at IAAPA Expo 2026, including the Legends Panel, Leadership Breakfast, and Lunch and Learn events. These high-profile sessions typically offer strategic insights from industry leaders that are directly applicable to FEC business planning. Operators and investors attending IAAPA Expo should prioritize these sessions for networking and thought leadership.

articles.title: International Ride Training Launches European Affiliate to Expand Safety and Consulting Services
articles.summary: International Ride Training has established IRT Attractions Consulting, SLU, a new European affiliate based in Madrid, to better serve the growing demand for operational safety, training, and auditing services across Europe. The expansion signals increasing global emphasis on ride safety standards and third-party certification in the attractions industry. FEC operators with ride-based attractions should consider how third-party safety auditing fits into their risk management programs.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe Preview: Maximizing Revenue Beyond the Core Attraction
articles.summary: Ahead of IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, industry experts are urging attraction operators to better monetize the brands, stories, and IP behind their headline experiences through retail, hospitality, and complementary programming. The argument is that secondary revenue streams like food and beverage and merchandise are often underdeveloped relative to the investment made in core attractions. FEC operators should treat this as a practical prompt to audit and expand their ancillary revenue strategies.

articles.title: Imagicaaworld Raises 248 Crore by Selling Hotel Asset to Fund Amusement Park Growth
articles.summary: India's largest amusement and water park operator, Imagicaaworld, has approved the sale of its Novotel Imagicaa hotel for 248 crore rupees, using the proceeds to fund its next phase of entertainment park expansion. The strategic divestiture of non-core hospitality assets to reinvest in core attractions is a notable capital allocation model for FEC investors and operators to consider. The move also reflects growing investor confidence in India's amusement park sector.

articles.title: Immersive 2.0: How the Experiential Entertainment Genre is Evolving
articles.summary: The immersive entertainment sector is maturing beyond its first wave of pop-up experiences into more sophisticated, technology-driven and narratively rich environments. For FEC operators, understanding this evolution is critical as guest expectations for immersive experiences continue to rise. Venues that can integrate storytelling, interactivity, and technology into cohesive experiences will have a competitive advantage.

articles.title: Merlin Introduces Virtual Queue App for Guests with Accessibility Needs Across UK Parks
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments is rolling out a new app-based virtual queuing system for guests who use its Ride Access Pass across UK theme parks, beginning at Alton Towers and expanding chainwide by summer 2027. The move follows significant public criticism over earlier attempts to restrict accessibility accommodations and reflects the growing importance of inclusive guest experience design. FEC operators should review their own accessibility queue management policies in light of this high-profile industry shift.

articles.title: KAIQI Offers Turnkey FEC Design and Factory-Direct Installation Services
articles.summary: KAIQI is promoting a turnkey family entertainment center design service that combines custom space engineering with direct factory installation, targeting operators looking to reduce development complexity and costs. Turnkey FEC suppliers are increasingly important for first-time operators and franchise developers entering the market. Operators evaluating new builds or renovations should assess turnkey suppliers against traditional design-bid-build approaches.

articles.title: Dubai Parks and Resorts Sets October 7 Opening Date for Integrated Theme Park Destination
articles.summary: Dubai Parks and Resorts has confirmed October 7, 2026 as its official opening date, bringing together MOTIONGATE Dubai, Real Madrid World, LEGOLAND Dubai Resort, and the World of Riverland entertainment district under one destination. The opening of one of the Middle East's largest integrated entertainment complexes marks a significant moment for the global FEC and theme park industry. Operators and investors tracking large-format entertainment destination development internationally should monitor this launch closely.

articles.title: ProSlide Strengthens EMEA Technical Support with New Waterpark Operations Hire
articles.summary: ProSlide has added Arun Thangaraj to its EMEA team in a technical service support role, bringing four years of waterpark operations experience from Atlantis the Palm. The hire signals ProSlide's commitment to post-installation service quality in a growing regional market. FEC and waterpark operators in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa may benefit from improved manufacturer support for ProSlide equipment.

articles.title: Pirate Pete's FEC Opens with Themed Family Entertainment Offering
articles.summary: Pirate Pete's, a new themed family entertainment center, has opened its doors and is welcoming guests with a pirate-themed experience designed to appeal to families. Themed FECs with strong character-driven identities are increasingly popular as a differentiation strategy in competitive markets. Operators developing new venues should note how immersive theming can build brand loyalty from day one.
